experienceSubheading: A career is more useful when you can see the problems behind the titles.
aboutText: I'm most useful when the problem is complex, the answer isn't obvious, and different stakeholders see different versions of the truth. That's usually where structure, strategy and good execution matter most.
thinkingSubheading: Notes on strategy, transformation, technology, organisations, scaling and the problems leaders don't always have time to think through.
advisoryHeading: When the problem is bigger than a meeting.
advisoryText: I work selectively with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and organisations navigating important transitions — from defining what needs to change to designing and building what comes next.
speakingText: Parul speaks on strategy, transformation, technology, scaling, emerging businesses, leadership and building organisations for what comes next.
impactText: Building institutions and communities, not only businesses — including work with ABWCI / Women in Supply Chain.
finalCtaHeading: Have a difficult problem to think through?
finalCtaText: I'm always interested in thoughtful conversations around organisations, transformation, technology, emerging businesses and what comes next.
